# Workspace Instructions

## Zemax / OpticStudio Routing

- For any Zemax/OpticStudio zoom-lens task (变焦镜头、zoom lens、variable-focus, or Multi-Configuration Editor/MCE zoom design), load and follow the project skill at `.github/skills/zemax-zoom-lens-design/SKILL.md` before inspecting or changing the optical design.
- If an optical-design task's workspace, target folder, or lens-file name contains `Zoom`/`zoom`, treat that as an additional priority signal for the same skill. A name is only a routing hint; verify the requested file and live OpticStudio system before relying on project records.
- Use the skill's reference model and lab report as prior examples, not as a substitute for validating the current prescription. Keep Zemax-specific procedures in the skill so they are loaded only for relevant work.
